nodes.name: Lou Taylor
nodes.description: Business manager associated with Britney Spears' conservatorship; allegedly began career at Calvary Chapel Brentwood alongside her then-pastor husband; founder/principal of Tri Star (referenced as "Tristar" in transcript).

nodes.name: Brett Cooper
nodes.description: Host/creator of independent commentary show; source of two audio segments read aloud describing Lou Taylor and Britney Spears conservatorship details.

nodes.name: Rob Taylor
nodes.description: Lou Taylor's husband; pastor at Calvary Chapel Brentwood per Brett Cooper segment. Transcript renders the name in three different forms (Robin, Rob, Luke); the same individual is plainly referenced. Multiple occurrences warrant separate recording correction.

nodes.name: Jamie Spears (Jamie Lynn Spears's father; Britney Spears's father)
nodes.description: Conservator and conservatorship income recipient; tithing donor to Calvary Chapel Brentwood per 2010 financial document.

nodes.name: Courtney Love
nodes.description: Musician; subject of allegation that Lou Taylor attempted to place her under conservatorship (per New Yorker); source of January 2025 text messages describing alleged "Mormon mafia" and Haight-Ashbury experimentation.

nodes.name: Lindsay Lohan
nodes.description: Subject referenced in connection with Lou Taylor conservatorship allegations (New Yorker) and Michael Lohan press statement (Morning Star rehab leak).

nodes.name: Michael Lohan
nodes.description: Father of Lindsay Lohan; press statement cited accusing Lou Taylor and associates of leaking rehab information.

nodes.name: Bob Coy
nodes.description: Referenced as mentor of the Taylor family in Brentwood, Tennessee; subject of prior-day discussion in Episode 31; allegedly involved in sexual abuse scandal. Transcript renders the name as "Bob Coy."

nodes.name: R. Todd Nielson
nodes.description: Named in Courtney Love text screenshots as a "corrupt Fed" and as an LDS apostle. Single-source; unverified.

nodes.name: Bob Bryar
nodes.description: Drummer, My Chemical Romance; deceased; cause of death ruled undetermined per People magazine; per his own public Twitter post, was Lou Taylor's business manager for 18 years through September (year unspecified in transcript).

nodes.name: Samir
nodes.description: On-scene videographer at Kirk event; allegedly BYU alumnus; per host posted photo with maroon shirt person; allegedly permitted to interview Astrid Tuminez.

nodes.name: Butch Hibbs
nodes.description: Brother of Jack Hibbs; alleged by host to have been in the bush at Kirk event prior to shooting and to have lingered at scene post-shooting during media interviews.

nodes.name: Allie Beth Stuckey
nodes.description: Subject of Daily Mail and Wall Street Journal headlines framing her as TPUSA "heir" or "heir apparent." Host disputes framing on air.

nodes.description: Persistent investigation target. Samir is alleged to know the individual but declined to provide contact.

claims.label: Lou Taylor's Husband Pastored at Calvary Chapel Brentwood
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Brett Cooper says Lou Taylor began her career working in a church alongside her husband, who at the time was a pastor at Calvary Church in Brentwood, California.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Calvary Chapel Brentwood staff records circa 2005–2008 to confirm Lou Taylor's husband's pastoral role and tenure dates.

claims.label: Lou Taylor Lacked Formal Financial Qualifications
claims.claim: Brett Cooper states Lou Taylor had no financial background and was not an accountant, despite serving as a business manager.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via business filings (Tri Star / Tristar) and professional licensing records whether Lou Taylor held relevant financial credentials.

claims.label: Brett Cooper Says Jamie Spears Tithed Approximately 10% of Conservatorship Income to Calvary Chapel Brentwood
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Brett Cooper reads that Mr. Spears at times gave 10% of his conservatorship income to Calvary Chapel Brentwood, and that according to a 2010 financial document he gave "tens of thousands of dollars" in one year.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 2010 financial document referenced and confirm donor records at Calvary Chapel Brentwood.

claims.label: LA Times Reported Lawyer Emails Linked Lou Taylor to Conservatorship Setup
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Brett Cooper reads an LA Times headline saying Britney Spears's lawyer emails show her ex-business manager (Lou Taylor) helped set up the conservatorship.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and review the LA Times article and underlying email exhibits cited therein.

claims.label: Britney Spears Alleged Affair Between Jamie Spears and Lou Taylor
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Brett Cooper reads a Daily Mail headline saying Britney Spears accuses her father Jaime of having an affair with her ex-business manager Lou Taylor and claims he charged her estate for the pair's trip to the Holy Land to get baptized.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the underlying Daily Mail reporting and court documents cited; corroborate against any trial filings from Britney Spears's conservatorship termination proceedings.

claims.label: The New Yorker Reported Lou Taylor Attempted Conservatorships of Courtney Love and Lindsay Lohan
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Brett Cooper says The New Yorker reported that Lou Taylor also tried to place Courtney Love and Lindsay Lohan into conservatorships.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the underlying New Yorker article and review primary sourcing for both alleged conservatorship attempts.

claims.label: Michael Lohan Accused Lou Taylor of Leaking Lindsay Lohan Rehab Information
claims.claim: Michael Lohan (audio clip) states Lou Taylor and associates leaked to the press information about Lindsay Lohan's rehab, allegedly to redirect her to UCLA.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Lohan's public statement against contemporaneous press coverage of Morning Star / UCLA rehabs; review any subsequent litigation.

claims.label: Insider Email Alleges Lou Taylor and Rob Taylor's Church Is a Front with Intelligence Links
claims.claim: Per a partially redacted email the host reads, the sender says Rob and Lou Taylor's church is a front for "them and Aruse" (uncertain transcription) and suspects Lou Taylor is tied to possibly the CIA and Mossad and to Black Cube security. The host says she has not confirmed it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify sender through unredacted metadata; cross-reference Thousand Oaks property records and Black Cube Security client roster.

claims.label: Courtney Love Claims She Was Experimented on at Haight-Ashbury Clinic as a Toddler
claims.claim: The host says Courtney Love told her in messages (Jan 2025) that she was experimented on as a toddler at the Haight-Ashbury Clinic and was given LSD; the host describes this as the era when the CIA was dosing hippies in mass experimentation.
claims.investigative_direction: Court Love is reportedly writing a book on this topic; verify against any forthcoming publication and corroborate via Haight-Ashbury Clinic / CIA program historical records.

claims.label: Courtney Love Claims She Did Not Kill Kurt Cobain
claims.claim: The host says Courtney Love told her in messages (Jan 2025): "I did not kill Kurt Cobain. That was a part of a psychological operation to make the masses look away from what the CIA was guilty of."
claims.investigative_direction: Standalone claim only; no corroborating artifact in this episode.

claims.label: Courtney Love Alleges "Mormon Mafia" Sits Above Hollywood and "Zionist Jews"
claims.claim: Per Courtney Love text messages (Jan 2025), she alleges a "Mormon mafia" operates above Hollywood and above "many Zionist Jews."
claims.investigative_direction: Single-source; corroboration required before inscription as fact.

claims.label: Courtney Love Names Lou Taylor as Connected to Multiple High-Profile Figures
claims.claim: Per Courtney Love text messages (Jan 2025), she states Lou Taylor is connected to Kim Kardashian, Diddy, Jay-Z, and Beyoncé, and that Lou Taylor owns or sat on the board of a "church home" associated with Hillsong / Justin Bieber.
claims.investigative_direction: Review corporate filings of the named "church home" entity; cross-reference any disclosed business relationships.

claims.label: Bob Bryar Publicly Stated Lou Taylor Was His Business Manager for 18 Years
claims.claim: Per Bob Bryar's public Twitter/X post (October 2024 per host), Lou Taylor was his business manager for 18 years until separation in September (year not stated in transcript).
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Bryar's original tweet; cross-reference with any business filings linking Bryar to Tri Star.

claims.label: Bob Bryar's Cause of Death Ruled Undetermined; Nitrous Oxide Found Near Body
claims.claim: Per People magazine article (read on air), My Chemical Romance drummer Bob Bryar's cause of death was ruled undetermined, with nitrous oxide found near his body.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full autopsy / coroner's report; review toxicology findings.

claims.label: Individual in Maroon Shirt Observed Near Bush at Kirk Event; Did Not Duck When Shots Fired
claims.claim: The host describes an individual in a maroon shirt who was partially in the bush at the Kirk event; when Charlie went down, everyone ducked but he kept standing, went into and out of the bush and calmly walked away. She says this does not mean he is guilty of anything.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain high-resolution copies of all photos/video from multiple angles; cross-reference with FBI / state investigative files.

claims.label: Samir Posted Photo with Maroon Shirt Individual; Both Alleged BYU Alumni
claims.claim: Per host, "Samir" publicly posted a photo alongside the maroon shirt individual from the Kirk event and identified them both as BYU alumni.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the second individual in the Samir photo; confirm BYU attendance.

claims.label: Samir Was Permitted to Interview Astrid Tuminez
claims.claim: Per host, "Samir" was granted an interview with UVU president Astrid Tuminez despite the host's own inability to obtain basic contact information from him.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the published Samir / Tuminez interview and review sourcing/conditions.

claims.label: Butch Hibbs Lingered in Background During Post-Shooting Media Interview
claims.claim: The host says that in a clip she plays, recorded at the scene after the Kirk shooting, Butch Hibbs lingers in the background while another individual is interviewed by the media, "almost as if he wants to know what that person is telling the media."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Butch Hibbs's official role/access at the event; review any post-event investigative interviews.

claims.label: Daily Mail Headline Framed Allie Beth Stuckey as TPUSA "Heir"
claims.claim: The host says the Daily Mail (Victoria Churchill, whom she calls an APAC reporter) published a headline framing Allie Beth Stuckey as TPUSA's "heir" or equivalent.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the article and verify framing language; host disputes framing on air.

claims.label: Wall Street Journal Repeated "Heir Ali" / "Heir Apparent" Framing for TPUSA
claims.claim: The host says the Wall Street Journal repeated the "heir apparent" framing of Allie Beth Stuckey for TPUSA.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the WSJ article and verify framing language.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Articulated Preference for Foxhole-Style Friends in On-Air Conversation
claims.claim: Per replayed audio clip, Charlie Kirk stated that one wants friends who tell you where the bullets are coming from, not those who offer distractions, in a pre-assassination conversation with host.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify timestamp/date of original recording; confirm via original footage.

claims.label: Host Says Macron Side Raised MK Ultra 18 Times in Lawsuit Against Her
claims.claim: The host says Brigitte Macron and Emmanuel Macron reacted badly when she discussed MK Ultra and that their side brought it up 18 times in the lawsuit against her.
claims.investigative_direction: Count MK Ultra references in the Macron complaint as filed.
claims.transcript_snippet: They brought it up 18 times in the lawsuit against me.

claims.label: Host Says Kanye Was Put on a Psych 5150 Hold and MK Ultraed
claims.claim: The host says Kanye West (Ye) was put on a psych 5150 hold as part of a psychological operation and that this effectively amounted to being MK ultraed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain hospital or legal records of any 2016 or later involuntary hold on Kanye West, or his own public account.
claims.transcript_snippet: They put him on a psych 5150 hold which is one of their strategies and effectively he had been MK ultraed

claims.label: Host Says Weinstein Was Taken Out via Me Too and Me Too May Have Been Hostile Takeovers
claims.claim: The host says it was very weird that Harvey Weinstein was taken out via the Me Too movement and that she had posited that the movement may have been about hostile takeovers of companies.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace ownership changes at Miramax and The Weinstein Company after the 2017 allegations.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was very weird that they took out Harvey Weinstein. That is a fact. Via the Me Too movement. And I had posited to the audiences that that movement may have been about hostile takeovers of companies.

claims.label: Host Says Emails Tied Calvary Chapel to Britney Spears's Conservatorship
claims.claim: The host says a flurry of emails told her to stay the course because Calvary Chapel was also involved in Britney Spears's conservatorship.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the viewer emails and conservatorship filings showing any Calvary Chapel role.
claims.transcript_snippet: telling me to stay the course because the Calvary Chapel was also involved in Britney Spears's conservatorship.

claims.label: Host Says Lou Taylor Pushed for Britney's Conservatorship, as Alleged and Insinuated by Britney
claims.claim: The host says it has been alleged, and heavily insinuated even by Britney Spears herself, that Lou Taylor was very much involved in and pushed for the conservatorship.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Britney Spears's court statements and the 2021 LA Times emails for Lou Taylor's role.
claims.transcript_snippet: Lou Taylor uh apparently was very much involved. That is what has been heavily insinuated and even by Britney Spears herself.

claims.label: Cooper Says Lou Taylor Joined the Spears Orbit in 2007 to Manage Jamie Lynn
claims.claim: Brett Cooper (clip played) says Lou Taylor became involved with Britney Spears in 2007 after being hired to help manage Jamie Lynn Spears, and that by 2008 she was on TV as the family spokesperson.
claims.investigative_direction: Check 2007 to 2008 press coverage and the Spears family accounts for when Lou Taylor was hired.
claims.transcript_snippet: Lou Taylor became involved with Britney Spears in 2007 after she was hired to help manage Jaime Lynn Spears.

claims.label: Cooper Cites Lynn Spears Memoir on Conservatorship Talk With Lou Taylor
claims.claim: Brett Cooper (clip played) says Britney's mother wrote in her memoir Through the Storm that Lou Taylor and Britney's father had discussed putting Britney in a conservatorship shortly after Jamie Lynn got pregnant.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the passage in Lynn Spears's memoir Through the Storm.
claims.transcript_snippet: her mom stated in her memoir, Through the Storm, that Lou and Britney's father had discussed putting her in a conservatorship shortly after that happened.

claims.label: Cooper Says Lou Taylor's Firm Lent Jamie Spears $40,000 Months Before the Conservatorship
claims.claim: Brett Cooper (clip played) says Jamie Spears had allegedly filed for bankruptcy several times and that Lou Taylor's firm gave him a $40,000 loan, with the conservatorship implemented in February 2008 within months.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for bankruptcy filings and loan records for Jamie Spears and Lou Taylor's firm around 2007 and 2008.
claims.transcript_snippet: Jaime Senior had around this time allegedly filed for bankruptcy. He had done this multiple times, and Lou Taylor's firm gave Britney's dad a loan of $40,000.

claims.label: Cooper Says Tri Star Managed the Circus Tour Grossing $130 Million
claims.claim: Brett Cooper (clip played) says Jamie Spears committed Britney to an eight-month Circus tour, that Lou Taylor's company Tri Star was hired as business manager, and that the tour grossed an estimated $130 million.
claims.investigative_direction: Check conservatorship accountings for Circus tour gross and Tri Star fees.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tristar, that is L. Taylor's company, was hired to serve as the tour's business manager, handling its finances and accounting. And the tour grossed an estimated $130 million.

claims.label: Host Recaps Rob McCoy Stepping In as CFO of Potter's Field
claims.claim: The host recaps that Rob McCoy stepped in as CFO of Potter's Field, that there are articles about it, and that the organization essentially disappeared overnight.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the press articles and Montana filings on Potter's Field leadership and dissolution.
claims.transcript_snippet: Rob McCoy steps in as the CFO and there's articles about it and essentially this organization sort of disappears overnight.

claims.label: Host Relays Source Saying McCoy Staged a Hostile Takeover of Potter's Field
claims.claim: The host says a person involved with the Potter's Field scandal told her it was a healthy ministry until Rob McCoy got involved, intentionally scandalized it and staged a hostile takeover with other board members. She says it is alleged and the emails and backup need review before she presents it as fact.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the source's emails and backup and Potter's Field board minutes and financial filings.
claims.transcript_snippet: until Rob McCoy got involved and then he intentionally scandalized it and staged an effective hostile takeover with a few other board members.

claims.label: Host Says Two More Former Lou Taylor Associates Described a Mandatory Tithing System
claims.claim: The host says two other people who worked with Lou Taylor contacted her and described a system where clients had to give 10 percent to the church to be blessed and were directed to invest in other companies without necessarily being told that they were involved in those companies.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview the two sources and obtain client agreements or payment records showing tithing and undisclosed investments.
claims.transcript_snippet: two other people reached out to me who worked with Lou Taylor and described exactly what she's referring to.

claims.label: Email Alleges Lou Taylor Has Ties to Ghislaine Maxwell and Epstein
claims.claim: The host reads an email tip saying the writer has heard that Lou Taylor has connections to Ghislaine Maxwell and Epstein. The host says it is allegedly, an unconfirmed email tip.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the email's author for the basis; search Epstein and Maxwell records for Lou Taylor.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've also heard that Lou has connections and ties to Glen Maxwell and Epstein, etc.

claims.label: Email Says Britney's 2019 Location Was Tied to Epstein via Tony Blair
claims.claim: The email read by the host says a reporter told the writer that the house where Britney Spears was held in 2019 was tied to Epstein somehow via Tony Blair. The host says she has not confirmed it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the reporter and the property and check ownership records.
claims.transcript_snippet: they told me that the house that Britney was being held out in 2019 was tied to Epstein somehow via Tony Blair.

claims.label: Email Says Lou Taylor Built a House in Thousand Oaks and Likely Knows Rob McCoy
claims.claim: The email read by the host says Lou Taylor built a house in Thousand Oaks and that it would be very hard to believe she does not know Rob McCoy, who the email says was mayor of Thousand Oaks and pastors the large Calvary Chapel there.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Ventura County property records and any McCoy and Taylor connection.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know Lou Taylor built a house there and would find it very hard to believe that she does not know Rob McCoy, seeing that he was the mayor of Thousand Oaks

claims.label: Email Says Robin and Lou Taylor Were Mentored by Bob Coy in Fort Lauderdale
claims.claim: The email read by the host says Robin and Lou Taylor lived in Fort Lauderdale, attended a very large Calvary Chapel there and were mentored by Bob Coy, who mentored them in starting their Brentwood, Tennessee church. The host adds that Coy has been embroiled in sexual-allegation scandal and she believes had to step down.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale and Brentwood church histories for the Taylors and Coy.
claims.transcript_snippet: they lived in Fort Lauderdale, Florida and attended a very large Calvary Chapel church there. And they were mentored by a man named Bob Coy.

claims.label: Host Says Rob McCoy Pastored the Thousand Oaks Church Until July
claims.claim: The host says Rob McCoy has been pastoring the Thousand Oaks church for a very long time up until July of this year, and agrees Lou Taylor likely knows him.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the date McCoy left Calvary Chapel Thousand Oaks and who succeeded him.
claims.transcript_snippet: he's been pastoring that church up until July of this year for a very long time.

claims.label: Host Says Kanye Asked Her 'Are You an OP' When Adidas and Gap Dropped Him
claims.claim: The host says that in her house, while Adidas and Gap were cancelling him, Kanye West asked her whether she was an OP, which she later understood as asking if she was part of a psychological operation.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Kanye West or others present to corroborate; compare with the host's earlier accounts of that visit.
claims.transcript_snippet: Adidas was cancelling him and Gap was cancelling him. He was like, "Are you an OP 2? Are you an OP 2?"

claims.label: Host Relays Courtney Love Thesis That Powerful Targets Get Handlers Then Hostile Takeovers
claims.claim: The host says Courtney Love told her in messages that when companies or individuals get too big and powerful, agents are sent to control them, and if they cannot be controlled a hostile takeover of the brand, company or person is staged.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Courtney Love messages and ask Love to confirm what she meant.
claims.transcript_snippet: when companies or individuals get too big and become too powerful, they send their agents to control them

claims.label: Host Says Britney and Kanye Were Put on 5150 Holds and Kim Kardashian Was Fine With It
claims.claim: The host says Britney Spears was put on a psych 5150 hold and that Kanye West, who she says said he was just reading a Bible, was put in a hospital on a psych 5150 hold, with his then-wife Kim Kardashian, she guesses, fine with it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain hospital or court records, or statements from Kardashian or West on the 2016 hospitalization.
claims.transcript_snippet: Britney's been put on a psych 5150 hold. Kanye, he said he was just reading a Bible and Harley Pasternak and we got into his backstory and MK Ultra. uh suddenly puts him in a hospital on a psych 5150 hold and somehow his wife I guess was cool with that

claims.label: Host Cites Lawfare Bankruptcy Strategy and Says It Applies to Elijah Schaffer
